programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: To win the heart of his beloved, a young man (Charlie Cox) ventures into the realm of fairies to retrieve a fallen star (Claire Danes).

programme.title: Nancy Drew
programme.desc: Accompanying her father on a business trip to Hollywood, the young sleuth (Emma Roberts) investigates the long-unsolved death of a movie star.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement.

programme.title: Yours, Mine & Ours
programme.desc: A household threatens to burst at the seams when the marriage of two widowed parents creates a family of 18 children.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: JFK, LBJ, Vietnam, Watergate and other history unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man (Tom Hanks) with an IQ of 75.

programme.title: Smoke Signals
programme.desc: A geeky American Indian travels from Idaho to Phoenix with a stoic companion whose father died.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: A being with the ability to manipulate the four elements joins forces with a waterbender and her brother to restore balance to their war-torn world.

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

programme.title: Show Dogs
programme.desc: A hot tip leads a canine cop and an FBI agent to Las Vegas to recover a stolen baby panda. Working undercover at a dog show, the crime-fighting duo must now foil another kidnapping plot and rescue other valuable animals from a gang of smugglers.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Members (Andre Gower, Robby Kiger) of a monster fan club meet Count Dracula, Wolfman, Frankenstein, the Mummy and Gill Man.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Siblings (Freddie Highmore, Sarah Bolger) learn that magical creatures are behind the strange occurrences at their great-great-uncle's rundown estate.

programme.title: On the Line
programme.desc: A shy man (Lance Bass) scours the streets of Chicago in search of a vivacious woman (Emmanuelle Chriqui) he met on a train.

programme.title: 4:44 Last Day on Earth
programme.desc: Two lovers (Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh) immerse themselves in sex, art and other activities after word breaks that the world will end by the next morning.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension

programme.title: The Autopsy of Jane Doe
programme.desc: When father and son coroners investigate the death of a beautiful "Jane Doe," they find increasingly bizarre clues.

programme.title: Vicious
programme.desc: A strange ritual soon unravels into a waking nightmare when a woman receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: When his new assignment goes awry, an elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him.

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival.

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury

programme.title: Bleed for This

programme.title: Rock of Ages

programme.desc: A lieutenant colonel and approximately 400 U.S. troops battle 2,000 North Vietnamese soldiers in 1965.

programme.title: Changing Lanes
programme.desc: An attorney and a recovering alcoholic have a car accident which swiftly escalates into an ongoing, bitter feud.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: Monsters come in many forms.

programme.desc: A ghost prompts a lethal battle of wills between a man's new fiancée and his two daughters, one of whom has just returned from a mental ward.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: S03 E34 — Young Man's Fancy Newlywed Alex Walker returns to his home and yearns for the days of his childhood.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: S03 E03 — The Shelter A group of neighbors turns into a hostile mob when they try to invade one family's bomb shelter, believing a UFO attack is imminent.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: S05 E08 — Uncle Simon A wealthy old man makes life difficult for his greedy niece even after he dies.

programme.title: Inside
programme.desc: A high-end art thief becomes trapped inside a luxury, high-tech penthouse in New York's Times Square after his heist doesn't go as planned. Locked inside with nothing but priceless works of art, he must use all his cunning and invention to survive.

programme.title: The Intruder
programme.desc: A couple buy their dream home from a lonely widower in the California countryside. When he starts to interfere in their daily lives, they soon find themselves caught up in a violent confrontation that threatens to destroy everything they hold dear.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Psycho Leatherface (Robert Jacks) and his gruesome clan terrorize a high-schooler (Renée Zellweger) who loses her way the night of her prom.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S10 E07 — Getting to the Roots Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E10 — A Mayan League of their Own In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Tuscan Farmhouse Classics Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Making Pizza in Naples Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S01 E07 — Fast Paced Roman Recipes Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S01 E08 — Italian Alps Comfort Food Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Jarred Pepper Pasta and Sheet Pan Brisket Jamie cooks a speedy jarred-pepper pasta, crispy chicken in baked-bread sauce, and a beef brisket tray bake - all prepped in minutes. He makes shelf-raid spiced haricot beans, and rounds it all off with a fast and simple strawberry & balsamic tart.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Smash Burger and Creamy Chicken with Mushrooms Jamie cooks a midweek meal of speedy sweet pea chicken, a juicy Smash burger and a chicken and mushroom rice traybake. He batch-cooks his seven-veg sauce, followed by a spicy fish soup. And finishes off with a perfect pudding of tinned fruit granita.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Easy Pantry Staple Fish Cakes Jamie shares a simple salmon dish perfect for a midweek meal, and some no-fuss fish cakes made from tins. He cooks a lamb Madras traybake, as well as a no-cook pasta sauce, and crowns it all off with a hot and crispy ice cream parcel!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Creamy Chicken Pot Pie and Chocolate Tiramisu Jamie cooks a midweek traybake of roast veg and Camembert. He turns poached chicken into a creamy chicken & chive pie, serves up his easy green chilli salsa under sizzling butterflied prawns, and finishes it all off with decadent chocolate tiramisù.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S09 E10 — Hacienda Ranch Food Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E08 — Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E05 — The Magic of Piloncillo The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E07 — Cantina Culture and the Morning After? Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course
programme.desc: S01 E10 — Special Occasion Menus Gordon teaches us how to cook for special occasions, including stuffed lamb with spinach and pine nuts, Vietnamese-style fresh prawn rolls and a sumptuous whole sea bass stuffed with fennel, lemon and capers.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Baking 101 Gordon turns his focus to home baking. Recipes include his flavor-packed olive, tomato and rosemary focaccia, quick flatbreads with lemon, thyme and ricotta and a spectacular sponge with fresh ginger.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Stress Free Cooking Gordon's tackles stress-free cooking with recipes including sticky pork ribs, meatballs four ways and an amazing chilli chicken with ginger and coriander that just gets better and better with time.

programme.title: Let Frankie Cook
programme.desc: S01 E07 — Thanksgiving Spatchcock & Sides Frankie skips the stress and roasts a juicy spatchcocked turkey, then goes big on sides-cardamom rolls, Sweet & Savory Dauphinoise Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts with Bacon Jam, and a bright Citrus Salad with smoked salt.

programme.title: Let Frankie Cook
programme.desc: S01 E01 — The Wonderful World of Pizza Frankie makes pizza magic with two incredible doughs, turning his kitchen into a pizza party with grilled sausage pizza, cheesy Grandma Pies, golden Panzerotti, and a sweet dessert pizza topped with ricotta, berries, and honey.

programme.title: Let Frankie Cook
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Pasta From Scratch Frankie explores his Italian roots, pairing each pasta shape with its perfect sauce-from Cavatelli with Super Green Sauce to Pappardelle in pork ragout, ricotta Gnocchi with punchy anchovy pecorino, and cozy Squash Orzotto with bloomed poppy seeds.

programme.title: Let Frankie Cook
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Pancake Stacks and Snacks for Two Frankie flips the script for his wife Heather making breakfast for dinner featuring Banana Maple Pancakes, Eggs Benedict with prosciutto cotto, Home Fries with Bloody Mary Ketchup, Sausage Scrapple, and a boozy Espresso Milkshake.

programme.title: Let Frankie Cook
programme.desc: S01 E08 — Frankie's Feast of the Seven Fishes Frankie reimagines the Feast of the Seven Fishes with a shellfish-free spread making Smoked Whitefish Salad, Anchovy Butter Toast, Salt-baked Red Snapper, Trout Scapece, and Pasta con le Sarde, with a helping hand from his mom.

programme.title: Let Frankie Cook
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Lunch That Goes the Distance Frankie fuels up for action making hot Oatmeal, and Energy Date Balls, before he cooks up the perfect post-ride feast of cheesy Juicy Lucy Burgers, Ramp-loaded pasta salad, and a maple ginger switchel to cool it all down.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E07 — No Kitchen No Problem Frankie shows us easy and inventive no-kitchen hacks for delicious struggle meals. No Kitchen? No problem.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S04 E08 — Crunchy Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S02 E10 — Hot Dishes You say hot dishes, Frankie says casserole. Either way, these one-pot hot dishes are an affordable way to feed a group of people, or the family for dinner. Plus they're great to freeze for future meals.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S09 E11 — Breakfast for Dinner It's dinnertime and breakfast is on the menu this week. These affordable breakfast specials are hearty enough for dinner, and so delicious they may even taste better after dark. Grab a fork and dig in for the most important meal of the day!

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S09 E05 — Happy Halloween Trick or treat! These affordable, spooky Halloween-spirited dishes are hard to beat!

programme.title: Baking the Holidays
programme.desc: S02 E04 — Hair-raising Halloween Cakes Join Mia — these Halloween cakes are sure to SCARE! Blood-red velvet cake, marshmallow spiderwebs, bubbling cauldrons and a cake that bites back will inspire some serious spooky vibes. Mia will seriously impress and teach you new skills.

programme.title: Baking the Holidays
programme.desc: S02 E03 — Trick or Treats for Kids Whether you have kids or are a kid at heart, these whimsical Halloween treats are delicious, easy bakes. From leftover Halloween candy bark to ghostly treats and monster cakes. These recipes are perfect to make with little ones.

programme.title: Baking the Holidays
programme.desc: S02 E05 — Spooky Halloween Party Bakes Make your Halloween Party the talk of every boy and ghoul in the neighborhood! Whether it's the poisoned apples, the drippy candle cakes, coffin pies or savory treats (or tricks) - these delicious bakes will surely delight and scare.

programme.title: Halloween Candy Lovers Will Hate This Ranking
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Forking Delicious: Top 10 Halloween Candies On this episode of Forking Delicious, it's Halloween, and you can't have tricks without the treats! It's a sugary smackdown as our panel of treat-loving tricksters count down your top 10 Halloween candies of all time!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.desc: S01 E10 — Jamie Makes the World's Best Christmas Lasagne Jamie throws the most festive Christmas Party! The menu includes cheesy filo parcels, a make-ahead Christmas cauliflower lasagne, and jerk-rubbed hasselback root veg with chicken kebabs. He finishes with a fudgy sticky toffee coffee pudding.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.desc: S01 E11 — Jamie's Show-Stopping Christmas Porchetta Jamie welcomes his family to his outdoor shed for Christmas dinner! He swaps turkey for a show-stopping festive porchetta, served with crispy roast potatoes. The menu also includes a veggie Brussels sprouts pie and a mulled wine pear pavlova.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.desc: S01 E09 — Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Caprese Chicken Burgers and Pork and Fennel Ragu From crispy, herby Caprese chicken burgers to golden spinach pies, creamy pork & fennel ragù with fresh pappardelle, and a comforting tinned peach cobbler with fruit-rippled cream, Jamie proves budget-friendly cooking can be utterly delicious.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Creamy Broccoli & Blue Cheese Gnocchi and Beef & Potato Pasties With inspiration to make everyday ingredients into feasts for less, Jamie shares his version of beef & potato pasties, a homemade gnocchi using leftover cheese, fish cakes made from the store cupboard and a retro dessert brought bang up to date.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Silky Eggplant Noodles and Nostalgic Custard Tart Jamie makes an epic toad in the hole with onion gravy, silky aubergine noodles with peanuts and mint, a comforting and thrifty chicken, sausage & white bean bake with cabbage cake, and a nostalgic jam treacle tart with old-school custard.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Gnarly Celeriac Skewers and Cozy Tomato Soup Jamie wraps up the series with a gnarly celeriac skewer & flatbread feast, a hearty spiced cauliflower bake complete with edible lid, a steaming winter chilli that's good for your health and for your wallet and two delicious ways to elevate lunch.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Hearty Chicken Pot Pie and French Toast Crumpets with Bacon From a cosy chicken hotpot with braised cabbage to cheesy French-toast crumpets with smashed peas and bacon, a quick, aromatic fish curry, and a golden pear & almond cake with orange drizzle, Jamie proves simple ingredients really can shine.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Homemade Bagels with Egg Salad and Cherry Chocolate Mousse Jamie's Thai red chicken & squash traybake uses clever tips to get more for your money, a sardine puttanesca proves budget doesn't mean basic, a bagel recipe creates a low-cost lunch and his cherry chocolate mousse is a little bit of low-cost luxury.

programme.title: NCIS

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.
